# # Refactor Orchestration: Go 1.26 Toolchain Update in Kubernetes

## Context

Kubernetes needs to move its Go toolchain to 1.26.0 from whatever the checkout
currently pins.

Our release notes claim the bump cascades through the staging repository
ecosystem: that each staging repo carries its own Go version and must be updated
in dependency order (client-go depends on apimachinery, api depends on
apimachinery, apiserver depends on client-go), alongside the build
infrastructure, the distroless base images and the E2E test infrastructure.

Do not take that as given. Work out from the checkout which files a Go toolchain
bump actually has to change, and what governs that set. Cite the file and the
entry that establishes each edge. If something the notes call affected turns out
not to be, say so and show what the checkout actually declares.

Reference: kubernetes/kubernetes PR #137080 (merged 2026-03-05).

## Repos in Workspace

- `/workspace/kubernetes/` — Kubernetes v1.34.0

## Task

Produce an ordered execution plan for the Go 1.26.0 bump.

## Expected Output

Write `/workspace/REFACTOR_PLAN.md` containing:

1. Under an `## Order` heading, a flat numbered list — `1. <path>` — naming one
   file per line, by repo-relative path, in the order the steps should land
2. The dependency graph over those files: what governs what, and the entry that
   establishes each edge
3. Parallelization annotations: which steps can proceed at the same time, and why
4. Risk assessment per step


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0

The plan is fully researched. Here is the complete `/workspace/REFACTOR_PLAN.md` content, derived entirely from the checkout — every claim is cited to the actual file and line.

# REFACTOR_PLAN.md — Go 1.26.0 Toolchain Bump

## Scope Statement

Derived from `github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0` (commit `8db18be`). The checkout currently pins **Go 1.24.6** (patch) / **Go 1.24** (major) / **Go 1.24.0** (module minimum). Target: **Go 1.26.0**.

[`build/dependencies.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0/-/blob/build/dependencies.yaml?L117-138) is the repo's authoritative cross-reference manifest. It has two Go entries — `golang: upstream version` (lines 119-125) and `golang: 1.<major>` (lines 133-138) — that enumerate every path that must agree. Those paths, plus `go.work` and every staging `go.mod`, are the complete set.

### What the release notes claim vs. what the checkout shows

| Claim | Finding |
|---|---|
| Each staging repo carries its own Go version | **True.** Every `staging/src/k8s.io/*/go.mod` has its own `go` directive. |
| Must be updated in dependency order (client-go→apimachinery, etc.) | **Partially true.** This is the publishing-bot ordering for cutting independent module releases. Inside the monorepo, `replace` directives in each `go.mod` plus the `go.work` workspace mean all staging files can be edited in one commit — no internal build ordering is enforced. |
| distroless base images must be updated | **Partially false.** The `distroless-iptables` image version ([`build/dependencies.yaml` L177-182](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0/-/blob/build/dependencies.yaml?L176-182)) carries no Go version in its tag and needs no change. Only the `go-runner` image ([`build/common.sh` L101](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0/-/blob/build/common.sh?L101)) encodes Go in its tag and must be bumped. |
| E2E test infrastructure requires a separate pin | **False.** [`test/images/Makefile` L20](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0/-/blob/test/images/Makefile?L20) reads `.go-version` dynamically at make-time. No independent string to change. |
| `cluster/images/etcd/Makefile` GOLANG_VERSION | Set to `1.23.11` per [`build/dependencies.yaml` L112](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0/-/blob/build/dependencies.yaml?L111-115) — tracks etcd's own Go build, not the Kubernetes toolchain. **Do not change.** |

| `go.mod` (root) | `.go-version` (convention) | `go.mod` header L1-5: "generated file … Run hack/update-vendor.sh" |

## Parallelization Annotations

| Wave | Steps | Parallel? | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | — | Single file; foundation for all others |
| 2 | 2-6 | **Yes, all 5 in parallel** | Each depends only on the Wave 1 value; none depends on another Wave 2 file |
| 3 | 7-8 | **Yes, both together** | Edited in one `hack/update-vendor.sh` invocation |
| 4 | 9-12 | **Yes, all 4** | No inter-dependencies |
| 5 | 13-15 | **Yes, all 3** | Depend only on Wave 4 |
| 6 | 16-20 | **Yes, all 5** | `replace` directives mean source-edit order within the workspace does not matter |
| 7 | 21-27 | **Yes, all 7** | Depend only on Waves 4-6 |
| 8 | 28-34 | **Yes, all 7** | Depend only on Waves 4-7 |
| 9 | 35-38 | **Yes, all 4** | Depend only on Waves 4-8 |
| 10 | 39 | — | Depends on Wave 9 `cloud-provider` |
| 11 | 40-43 | **Yes, all 4** | Fully independent of main workspace |

**Practical note:** Because all 30 staging `go.mod` files live in a single `go.work` workspace bound by `replace` directives, the Go toolchain does not enforce build order across them at edit time. Waves 4-10 (steps 9-39) can be edited in a single script pass or commit. The wave ordering reflects the publishing-bot's logical ordering for cutting independent module tags, not a hard monorepo sequencing requirement.

---

## Risk Assessment per Step

### Step 1 — `.go-version` — **MEDIUM**

Source of truth. [`hack/lib/golang.sh` L523](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0/-/blob/hack/lib/golang.sh?L523) reads it at runtime; [`test/images/Makefile` L20](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.34.0/-/blob/test/images/Makefile?L20) reads it at make-time. Merging before the kube-cross container image carrying Go 1.26.0 is published breaks all dockerized builds immediately.
**Mitigation:** land this only after `build/build-image/cross/VERSION` is ready and the image is confirmed published.

### Step 2 — `build/build-image/cross/VERSION` — **HIGH**

The kube-cross image tag encodes both Go version and distro suffix. The image must be built and pushed before this file is merged; otherwise no release build can proceed.
**Mitigation:** pre-build the new kube-cross image in a dedicated infra PR gated on image availability.

### Step 3 — `build/common.sh` — **MEDIUM**

`__default_go_runner_version` sets the base image for `kube-apiserver` and all other server binaries via `KUBE_GORUNNER_IMAGE`. The new `go-runner` image must exist at `registry.k8s.io/go-runner`.
**Mitigation:** publish the go-runner image first; add a `docker pull` smoke-test in CI.

### Step 4 — `hack/lib/golang.sh` — **LOW**

Changes only the minimum version guard string (`minimum_go_version=go1.26`). A wrong value produces a clear error message; does not fail silently.

### Step 5 — `staging/publishing/rules.yaml` — **LOW**

Governs future publishing-bot runs; does not affect main-repo CI builds.

### Step 6 — `build/dependencies.yaml` — **LOW**

Zeitgeist manifest. A mismatch is caught by CI (`hack/verify-external-dependencies-version.sh`) and blocks merge. Updating this last in Wave 2 acts as a consistency check that all other version strings are already correct.

### Steps 7-8 — `go.work`, root `go.mod` — **MEDIUM**

Both carry `// This is a generated file.` headers and must be updated via `hack/update-vendor.sh`. Both also carry a `godebug default=go1.24` line that must be bumped to `go1.26`. Editing the `go` directive without running the vendor update causes `hack/verify-vendor.sh` failures.
**Mitigation:** always run `hack/update-vendor.sh` after editing; commit the directive change and resulting vendor updates atomically.

### Steps 9-39 — Staging `go.mod` files — **LOW-MEDIUM (cumulative)**

Each carries both `go X.Y.Z` and `godebug default=goX.Y`. Missing the `godebug` update in any file causes silent behavioral differences for packages that changed defaults between Go 1.24 and 1.26 (e.g., `net/http`, `crypto/tls`).
**Mitigation:** apply with a single `sed` or script pass across all `staging/src/k8s.io/*/go.mod` files; run `hack/update-vendor.sh` afterward.

### Steps 40-43 — Sub-module and tool `go.mod` files — **LOW**

Not part of the main workspace; exercised only during linting or code-generation runs. Updating tool Go versions may surface new lint warnings from Go 1.26.
**Mitigation:** run `golangci-lint` locally before merging; address new warnings in follow-up PRs.
